title: Statistics and probability
summary: Types of data, mean, median, mode and range, graphs including stem-and-leaf and sector graphs, and theoretical and experimental probability.

cards.title: Collecting and classifying data
cards.rule: Categorical data is groups. Numerical data is numbers.
lines: Primary: you collect it. Secondary: someone else did.

cards.title: Summarising data
cards.rule: Mean: add and divide. Median: middle in order. Mode: most common. Range: max − min.

cards.title: Column graphs and dot plots
cards.rule: Give it a title, label both axes and use an equal scale.
lines: Column graphs: leave gaps between columns
Dot plots: one dot for each result

cards.title: Line graphs
cards.rule: Show change over time, with time on the horizontal axis.
lines: Look for rising, falling and flat parts

cards.title: Stem-and-leaf plots
cards.rule: The stem is the tens, the leaf is the units. Include a key.

cards.title: Sector and divided bar graphs
cards.rule: Each part of the circle or bar shows a share of the whole.
lines: A quarter of a circle is \(90^\circ\)

cards.title: Experimental probability
cards.rule: Relative frequency \(= \dfrac{\text{times it happened}}{\text{number of trials}}\)
lines: 12 heads in 40 tosses: \(\tfrac{12}{40} = 0.3\). The theoretical probability is 0.5.
More trials usually get closer to the theoretical probability.
